text.p: InVision Technologies Inc Monday said it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission in connection with a proposed underwritten public offering of 3,125,000 shares of common stock.
In a statement, the company said 1,875,000 shares are being offered by the company and 1,250,000 shares are being offered by certain selling stockholders.

The company said it intends to use the proceeds from the offering to purchase capital equipment and undertake facility improvements, to fund research and development, to increase funds available for working capital and for other general corporate purposes.
The company will not receive any proceeds from the sale of common stock by the selling stockholders.
